recent: Impact Capital Holdings Berhad 于2026年11月24日在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，首次公开募股（IPO）发行96,690,000股新股，每股RM0.22。上市前后，多名董事及大股东申报了股权变动，包括董事认购股份及大股东权益披露。公司最近一期财报（2026年9月30日止季度）已公布，但未提供具体数据。
notable: 公司于2026年11月24日在ACE市场上市，IPO发行96,690,000股新股，发售价每股RM0.22。
多名董事在上市时认购公司股份，包括独立非执行主席Datu William Anak Patrick Nyigor等以每股RM0.22认购200,000股。
执行董事Chyr Ye Hong于2026年11月20日交易74,880,000股（占15.6%），代价为零。
risks: 执行董事Chyr Ye Hong于2026年11月20日以零代价交易74,880,000股（占15.6%），需关注该股权变动的性质。
公司上市后多名董事及大股东申报股权变动，可能涉及股权结构变化。

INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF IMPACT CAPITAL HOLDINGS BERHAD ("IMPACT CAPITAL" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") COMPRISING: (I) PUBLIC ISSUE OF 96,690,000 NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN IMPACT CAPITAL ("SHARE(S)"

recent_en: Impact Capital Holdings Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 24 November 2026, with an IPO of 96,690,000 new shares at RM0.22 per share. Around the listing, several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in their interests, including director subscriptions and substantial shareholder disclosures. The company's latest quarterly report for the period ended 30 September 2026 was announced, but no specific financial figures were provided.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 24 November 2026, with an IPO of 96,690,000 new shares at an offer price of RM0.22 per share.
Several directors subscribed for shares at listing, including Independent Non-Executive Chairman Datu William Anak Patrick Nyigor and others who subscribed 200,000 shares each at RM0.22 per share.
Executive Director Chyr Ye Hong transacted 74,880,000 shares (15.6%) on 20 November 2026 at zero consideration.
risks_en: Executive Director Chyr Ye Hong transacted 74,880,000 shares (15.6%) at zero consideration on 20 November 2026; the nature of this share change warrants attention.
Several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in their interests after listing, which may involve changes in shareholding structure.
